fact: On 17 December 2025 the Grand Lomé district presented the feasibility study of a modernised addressing system covering 5,000 km of roads and 538,000 doors, updating 110,000 existing addresses and creating 428,000 new ones across its thirteen communes.
title: Vers une modernisation de l'adressage dans le Grand Lomé
publisher: Site officiel du Togo, République Togolaise
